title.zh: AI Tokens Flux｜Claude Code、Codex、Grok、Gemini API 统一网关
title.en: AI Tokens Flux | Unified Claude Code, Codex, Grok & Gemini API Gateway

description.zh: AI Tokens Flux 提供稳定的 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 与 Gemini API 统一接入，支持按量计费、透明模型价格、用量查询和快速配置。
description.en: AI Tokens Flux provides unified Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Gemini API access with usage-based billing, transparent model pricing and fast setup.

question.zh: AI Tokens Flux 会改变我现有的工具吗？
question.en: Will AI Tokens Flux change my existing tools?

answer.zh: 不会。它只在请求层重新路由，你的 Claude Code、Codex 和 VS Code 工作流、命令与脚本保持不变。
answer.en: No. It only reroutes requests, so your Claude Code, Codex and VS Code workflows, commands and scripts stay unchanged.

answer.zh: 按量余额永不过期；订阅方案会按各自的计费周期重置。
answer.en: Pay-as-you-go credits never expire. Subscription plans reset on their billing cycle.

answer.zh: 平台提供 Claude、OpenAI Codex、Grok 和 Gemini 等前沿模型的兼容 API，实际可用模型以价格页展示为准。
answer.en: The platform provides compatible APIs for frontier Claude, OpenAI Codex, Grok and Gemini models. Current availability is listed on the pricing page.

question.zh: 代码和请求数据安全吗？
question.en: Are my code and request data safe?

answer.zh: API Key 由用户自行管理并可随时吊销；网关不留存请求内容。
answer.en: API keys are user-managed and revocable at any time, and the gateway does not retain request content.
